intro: 本章只讲非线性**电阻**电路：方程不再是线性的，叠加定理不再成立，但线性部分仍可以用戴维宁定理化简。核心是工作点——用曲线相交（负载线）、解析或分段线性化的方法求出来，再用动态电阻做小信号分析。每求出一个解都要回到特性的适用范围里检验。

ideas.title: 非线性电阻及其分类
text: 电阻的 u–i 关系不是过原点的直线，就是**非线性电阻**（图形符号：电阻方框上加一条带短横的斜线）。它仍然是**无记忆**的：任一时刻的电流只由同一时刻的电压决定，所以本章的电路仍是“电阻电路”，只是方程不再是线性的。
**电压控制型（压控型）**：i 是 u 的单值函数 i = f(u)，如隧道二极管的 N 形特性——同一电流可以对应几个电压。**电流控制型（流控型）**：u 是 i 的单值函数 u = h(i)，如充气管的 S 形特性。**单调型**（如普通二极管、i = u + u³）既是压控型又是流控型。
**双向**电阻的曲线关于原点对称（f(−u) = −f(u)），两个端子可以互换；二极管是**单向**的，接反了电路的工作完全不同。

en.title: Nonlinear resistors and their classification
text: A resistor whose u–i relation is not a straight line through the origin is **nonlinear** (symbol: the resistor box crossed by an oblique stroke with a short foot). It is still **memoryless**: the current at any instant depends only on the voltage at that instant, so the circuits of this chapter are still resistive — only their equations are no longer linear.

**Voltage-controlled**: i is a single-valued function i = f(u), e.g. the N-shaped curve of a tunnel diode — one current can belong to several voltages. **Current-controlled**: u is a single-valued function u = h(i), e.g. the S-shaped curve of a gas discharge tube. A **monotonic** resistor (an ordinary diode, i = u + u³) is both.

A **bilateral** resistor has a curve symmetric about the origin (f(−u) = −f(u)) and its terminals can be swapped; a diode is **unilateral** — connected the other way round the circuit behaves completely differently.

ideas.title: 静态电阻与动态电阻
text: 在工作点 Q(U_Q，I_Q) 处，**静态电阻** R = U_Q/I_Q（Q 与原点连线），**动态电阻** R_d = du/di|_{Q}（Q 点切线的斜率），动态电导 G_d = di/du|_{Q} = 1/R_d。两者都随工作点变化；线性电阻处处 R = R_d。
静态电阻用来算工作点处的功率和比值；动态电阻描述**增量**：Δu ≈ R_d·Δi。曲线的下降段 R_d < 0（**负动态电阻**），这时元件仍在吸收功率（U_Q·I_Q > 0），只是电压增加时电流反而减小。曲线水平处 R_d = ∞，竖直处 R_d = 0。

en.title: Static and dynamic resistance
text: At the operating point Q(U_Q, I_Q) the **static resistance** is R = U_Q/I_Q (the line from the origin to Q) and the **dynamic resistance** is R_d = du/di at Q (the slope of the tangent), with dynamic conductance G_d = di/du = 1/R_d. Both depend on the operating point; for a linear resistor R = R_d everywhere.

The static resistance gives ratios and power at the operating point; the dynamic resistance describes **increments**: Δu ≈ R_d·Δi. On a falling part of the curve R_d < 0 (**negative dynamic resistance**): the element still absorbs power (U_Q·I_Q > 0), but its current falls as its voltage rises. Where the curve is horizontal R_d = ∞; where it is vertical R_d = 0.

ideas.title: 非线性电阻的串联与并联
text: **串联**：各元件电流相同，电压相加——在**同一个 i** 下把各曲线的 u 相加（横向叠加），得到等效特性 u = h_1(i) + h_2(i)。**并联**：电压相同，电流相加——在**同一个 u** 下把 i 相加（纵向叠加），i = f_1(u) + f_2(u)。
解析叠加要求函数形式匹配：流控型元件串联、压控型元件并联最方便。含二极管时等效特性也是分段的：例如二极管截止时，整条串联支路的电流为零。

en.title: Nonlinear resistors in series and in parallel
text: **Series**: the same current, voltages add — at **the same i** add the voltages of the curves (horizontal addition): u = h_1(i) + h_2(i). **Parallel**: the same voltage, currents add — at **the same u** add the currents (vertical addition): i = f_1(u) + f_2(u).

Adding analytically needs matching forms: current-controlled elements in series and voltage-controlled ones in parallel are the easy cases. With diodes the combined characteristic is piecewise too: with the diode off, a whole series branch carries no current.

ideas.title: 曲线相交法（负载线）
text: 电路中只有一个非线性电阻时，把**其余的线性部分**用戴维宁（或诺顿）定理化成 U_oc 串 R_0。KVL 给出一条直线 u = U_oc − R_0·i，叫**负载线**，它过 (U_oc，0) 和 (0，U_oc/R_0)。负载线与非线性电阻特性的交点就是**工作点 Q**。
线性部分含受控源时一样可以化简（受控源是线性元件），但求 R_0 要用开路电压/短路电流或外加电源法，**不能**把受控源置零。求出 U_Q、I_Q 后，用**替代定理**把非线性电阻换成 U_Q 的电压源（或 I_Q 的电流源），再回到原电路求其他支路的量。

en.title: Load-line (curve intersection) method
text: With a single nonlinear resistor, reduce **the rest of the circuit** (which is linear) to a Thevenin (or Norton) equivalent U_oc in series with R_0. KVL gives a straight line u = U_oc − R_0·i, the **load line**, through (U_oc, 0) and (0, U_oc/R_0). Its intersection with the characteristic is the **operating point Q**.

A linear part with dependent sources reduces the same way (dependent sources are linear elements), but find R_0 by open-circuit voltage / short-circuit current or a test source — **never** zero the dependent source. Once U_Q, I_Q are known, the **substitution theorem** lets you replace the nonlinear resistor by a U_Q voltage source (or an I_Q current source) to find the other branch quantities in the original circuit.

ideas.title: 解析法：解非线性方程并检验根
text: 特性有解析式时，把它代入负载线方程（或结点、回路方程）就得到一个非线性代数方程，平方律特性得到一元二次方程。
解出来的每个根都要**回代检查**：它是否落在特性公式的适用范围内（例如 i = au² 只对 u ≥ 0 成立）。不满足的根不是工作点，要舍去；满足的根可能不止一个，那就是多个工作点。

en.title: Analytic method: solve the nonlinear equation and check the roots
text: If the characteristic has a formula, substitute it into the load-line equation (or nodal / loop equations) to get a nonlinear algebraic equation; a square law gives a quadratic.

**Check every root**: does it lie in the range where the formula holds (e.g. i = au² only for u ≥ 0)? A root outside it is not an operating point and is rejected; if several roots pass, the circuit has several operating points.

ideas.title: 分段线性化法与理想二极管
text: 把特性近似成几段直线，每一段都可以写成 u = U_0k + R_k·i（电压源串电阻，R_k 是该段斜率，U_0k 是延长线在 u 轴上的截距），只在本段的范围内有效。**假设**工作点在某一段（或某几个元件各处于哪一段），用对应的线性电路求解，再**检验**结果是否落在所设的段内；不在就换一个假设。
**理想二极管**是最简单的两段特性：导通时 u = 0、i ≥ 0（短路），截止时 i = 0、u ≤ 0（开路）。加上开启电压 U_on 和导通电阻 R_on 就是“理想二极管 + 电压源 + 电阻”的模型。多个二极管时逐个假设状态，检验导通管电流 ≥ 0、截止管电压 ≤ U_on。

en.title: Piecewise-linear method and ideal diodes
text: Approximate the characteristic by straight segments; each is u = U_0k + R_k·i (a source in series with a resistor: R_k is the segment's slope, U_0k the intercept of its extension on the u axis), valid only inside the segment. **Assume** the operating point is on a segment (or which segment each element is on), solve that linear circuit, then **check** that the result lies in the assumed segments; if not, change the assumption.

The **ideal diode** is the simplest two-segment characteristic: on, u = 0 with i ≥ 0 (a short); off, i = 0 with u ≤ 0 (an open). Adding a turn-on voltage U_on and an on-resistance R_on gives the model "ideal diode + source + resistor". With several diodes assume each state, then check that conducting diodes carry current ≥ 0 and blocking ones have voltage ≤ U_on.

ideas.title: 多个工作点
text: 非单调的特性可以与负载线有多个交点：压控型的 N 形特性（隧道二极管）用电压源加串联电阻驱动时，可能有三个工作点；流控型的 S 形特性用电压源驱动时也可能有多个。工作点的个数随 U_s、R 变化。
哪个工作点会真正出现，要看稳定性：器件两端的寄生电容 C 看到的小信号电导是 1/R + 1/R_d，它为正时扰动衰减（稳定），为负时扰动增长（不稳定）。负阻段上的工作点在 |R_d| < R 时不稳定——这正是双稳态电路的原理。

en.title: Several operating points
text: A non-monotonic characteristic can meet the load line several times: an N-shaped voltage-controlled curve (tunnel diode) driven by a voltage source through a resistor can have three operating points, and so can an S-shaped current-controlled one driven by a voltage source. The number depends on U_s and R.

Which one actually occurs is a question of stability: the parasitic capacitance C across the device sees the small-signal conductance 1/R + 1/R_d. If it is positive a disturbance decays (stable); if negative it grows (unstable). An operating point on the negative-resistance segment with |R_d| < R is unstable — the principle of bistable circuits.

ideas.title: 小信号分析法
text: 激励 = 直流 U_s + 很小的变化量 u_s(t) 时，响应 ≈ 直流工作点 + 小信号分量：u = U_Q + u_1，i = I_Q + i_1。步骤：**① 只留直流源**，求工作点 Q；**② 求 Q 点的动态电阻** R_d；**③ 小信号等效电路**：直流源置零，非线性电阻换成 R_d，只留小信号源，求 u_1、i_1（正弦小信号可以用相量）；**④ 叠加**得到总响应。
依据是特性在 Q 点的泰勒展开 f(U_Q + u_1) ≈ f(U_Q) + f'(U_Q)·u_1：小信号足够小、曲线在这个范围内近似直线时才准确；若工作点在分段线性特性的一段内且信号不越过折点，结果就是精确的。小信号电路里用的是 R_d，不是静态电阻。

en.title: Small-signal analysis
text: With an excitation DC U_s + a small variation u_s(t), the response ≈ DC operating point + small-signal part: u = U_Q + u_1, i = I_Q + i_1. Steps: **① DC source only**: find Q; **② the dynamic resistance** R_d at Q; **③ small-signal equivalent circuit**: zero the DC sources, replace the nonlinear resistor by R_d, keep only the small-signal source and find u_1, i_1 (phasors work for a sinusoidal signal); **④ add** to get the total response.

It rests on the Taylor expansion at Q, f(U_Q + u_1) ≈ f(U_Q) + f'(U_Q)·u_1: accurate when the signal is small enough that the curve is nearly straight over its range; on one segment of a piecewise-linear characteristic, with the signal not crossing a corner, it is exact. The small-signal circuit uses R_d, not the static resistance.

formulas.name: 压控型 / 流控型
formulas.when: u、i 取关联参考方向。f 为单值函数即压控型，h 为单值函数即流控型；单调特性两者都是。双向：f(−u) = −f(u)。

en.name: Voltage- / current-controlled
en.when: Passive sign convention. Voltage-controlled if f is single-valued, current-controlled if h is; a monotonic characteristic is both. Bilateral: f(−u) = −f(u).

formulas.name: 静态电阻
formulas.when: 工作点 Q 处，关联参考方向；I_Q = 0 时无定义。

en.name: Static resistance
en.when: At the operating point Q, passive convention; undefined when I_Q = 0.

formulas.name: 动态电阻
formulas.when: Q 点切线斜率的倒数（u–i 图上 u 为横轴时）；下降段 R_d < 0，水平段 R_d = ∞，竖直段 R_d = 0；折点处无定义。

en.name: Dynamic resistance
en.when: Reciprocal slope of the tangent at Q (u on the horizontal axis); R_d < 0 on a falling part, ∞ where horizontal, 0 where vertical; undefined at a corner.

formulas.name: 非线性电阻吸收的功率
formulas.when: 直流工作点处，关联参考方向。不能用 R_d 计算功率。

en.name: Power absorbed by a nonlinear resistor
en.when: At the DC operating point, passive convention. Never compute power with R_d.

formulas.name: 串联等效特性
formulas.when: 串联：各元件电流相同（同一个 i），电压相加；适合流控型（或单调）元件。

en.name: Series combination
en.when: Series: the same current i through each element, voltages add; suits current-controlled (or monotonic) elements.

formulas.name: 并联等效特性
formulas.when: 并联：各元件电压相同，电流相加；适合压控型（或单调）元件。

en.name: Parallel combination
en.when: Parallel: the same voltage across each element, currents add; suits voltage-controlled (or monotonic) elements.

formulas.name: 负载线
formulas.when: U_oc、R_0 是从非线性电阻两端看进去的线性部分的戴维宁参数；i 从 U_oc 的“+”端流出、流入非线性电阻（关联方向）。工作点：同时满足 i = f(u)。

en.name: Load line
en.when: U_oc, R_0: Thevenin parameters of the linear part seen from the nonlinear resistor; i leaves the "+" of U_oc and enters the nonlinear resistor (its passive convention). Operating point: i = f(u) at the same time.

formulas.name: 分段线性模型
formulas.when: 只在第 k 段的范围内成立；R_k 为该段斜率（动态电阻），U_0k 为延长线在 u 轴上的截距。解出后必须检验结果在该段内。

en.name: Piecewise-linear segment
en.when: Valid only inside segment k; R_k is its slope (dynamic resistance), U_0k the intercept of its extension on the u axis. Check that the solution lies in the segment.

formulas.name: 理想二极管
formulas.when: u 为阳极对阴极电压，i 从阳极流入。带开启电压时导通条件为 u = U_on + R_on·i、i ≥ 0，截止条件为 u ≤ U_on。

en.name: Ideal diode
en.expr: on: u = 0, i ≥ 0;  off: i = 0, u ≤ 0
en.when: u from anode to cathode, i into the anode. With a turn-on voltage: on means u = U_on + R_on·i with i ≥ 0, off means u ≤ U_on.

formulas.name: 工作点的稳定性（并联寄生电容）
formulas.when: 非线性电阻经串联电阻 R 接电压源、两端并联寄生电容 C 时：小信号电路是一阶 RC 电路，τ = C/(1/R + 1/R_d)，τ > 0 稳定。

en.name: Stability of an operating point (parallel parasitic capacitance)
en.when: Nonlinear resistor driven by a voltage source through R, with a parasitic capacitance C across it: the small-signal circuit is first-order RC with τ = C/(1/R + 1/R_d); stable if τ > 0.

formulas.name: 小信号近似
formulas.when: |u_1|、|i_1| 足够小，使特性在 Q 附近近似为直线；u_1、i_1 由小信号等效电路求得（直流源置零，非线性电阻 → R_d）。

en.name: Small-signal approximation
en.when: |u_1|, |i_1| small enough that the characteristic is nearly straight around Q; u_1, i_1 come from the small-signal circuit (DC sources zeroed, nonlinear resistor → R_d).

formulas.name: 线性化的依据
formulas.when: 压控型 i = f(u)，在 Q 点一阶泰勒展开，忽略 u_1 的高次项；f'(U_Q) = G_d = 1/R_d。

en.name: Why linearisation works
en.when: Voltage-controlled i = f(u), first-order Taylor expansion at Q, higher powers of u_1 neglected; f'(U_Q) = G_d = 1/R_d.

examples.title: 戴维宁化简 + 负载线：平方律电阻的工作点
examples.statement: 图示电路中 U_s = 9 V，R_1 = 3 Ω，R_2 = 6 Ω，非线性电阻 N 的特性为 i = 0.5u²（u ≥ 0；u < 0 时 i = 0）。求工作点、R_1 中的电流、N 的静态电阻和动态电阻。
steps: 2. **负载线。** u = 6 − 2i，在特性图上是过 (6 V，0) 和 (0，3 A) 的虚线。
3. **解析求交点。** 代入 i = 0.5u²：u = 6 − u² → u² + u − 6 = 0 → (u − 2)(u + 3) = 0。u = −3 不在 u ≥ 0 的范围内（那里 i = 0，负载线却要求 i = 4.5），舍去：**U_Q = 2 V，I_Q = 2 A**，与图中的交点 Q 一致。

en.title: Thevenin reduction + load line: operating point of a square-law resistor
en.statement: U_s = 9 V, R_1 = 3 Ω, R_2 = 6 Ω; the nonlinear resistor N has i = 0.5u² (u ≥ 0; i = 0 for u < 0). Find the operating point, the current in R_1, and the static and dynamic resistances of N.
steps: 1. **Reduce only the linear part.** Remove N: U_oc = 9 × 6/(3 + 6) = **6 V**; short U_s: R_0 = 3 ∥ 6 = **2 Ω**.
2. **Load line.** u = 6 − 2i, the dashed line through (6 V, 0) and (0, 3 A) on the plot.

3. **Intersect analytically.** With i = 0.5u²: u = 6 − u² → u² + u − 6 = 0 → (u − 2)(u + 3) = 0. u = −3 is outside u ≥ 0 (there i = 0 while the load line needs i = 4.5), so it is rejected: **U_Q = 2 V, I_Q = 2 A**, the point Q on the plot.
4. **Back to the original circuit (substitution theorem).** u_a = U_Q = 2 V, **i_1 = (9 − 2)/3 ≈ 2.333 A**; R_2 carries 2/6 ≈ 0.333 A, KCL: 0.333 + 2 = 2.333 ✓.
5. **The two resistances.** Static R = 2/2 = **1 Ω**; dynamic di/du = u = 2 S, **R_d = 0.5 Ω**. Power P_N = 2 × 2 = **4 W**.

examples.title: 小信号分析：流控型电阻
examples.statement: 直流 U_s = 4 V 与小信号源 u_s(t) = 0.05cos(100t) V 串联，经 R = 2 Ω 给非线性电阻 N 供电，N 的特性为 u = i + i²（i ≥ 0；i < 0 时 u = 0）。求 N 的电压 u(t) 和电流 i(t)。
steps: 2. **动态电阻。** 流控型直接求导：R_d = du/di = 1 + 2i = **3 Ω**（静态电阻 R = 2/1 = **2 Ω**，两者不同）。
5. **检查（两次精确求解作差）。** 把 U_s 分别改为 4 + 0.05 V 和 4 − 0.05 V 精确求解 i² + 3i = U_s，两次电流之差的一半与 **I_1m = 0.01 A** 相差不到 0.01% ✓。若在第 3 步误用静态电阻 R = 2 Ω，会算出 U_1m = 0.05 × 2/4，偏小。

en.title: Small-signal analysis of a current-controlled resistor
en.statement: A DC source U_s = 4 V in series with a small-signal source u_s(t) = 0.05cos(100t) V feeds the nonlinear resistor N through R = 2 Ω; N has u = i + i² (i ≥ 0; u = 0 for i < 0). Find N's voltage u(t) and current i(t).
steps: 1. **DC operating point (u_s = 0).** KVL: 4 − 2i = i + i² → i² + 3i − 4 = 0 → (i − 1)(i + 4) = 0; i = −4 violates i ≥ 0 and is rejected: **I_Q = 1 A, U_Q = 2 V**.
2. **Dynamic resistance.** Current-controlled, so differentiate directly: R_d = du/di = 1 + 2i = **3 Ω** (the static resistance R = 2/1 = **2 Ω** is different).
3. **Small-signal circuit.** Short U_s and replace N by R_d = 3 Ω: u_1 = u_s·3/(2 + 3), **U_1m = 0.03 V**; **I_1m = 0.05/5 = 0.01 A**.
4. **Total response.** u(t) ≈ 2 + 0.03cos(100t) V, i(t) ≈ 1 + 0.01cos(100t) A.

5. **Check (difference of two exact solutions).** Solve i² + 3i = U_s exactly with U_s = 4 + 0.05 V and 4 − 0.05 V: half the difference of the two currents agrees with **I_1m = 0.01 A** to better than 0.01 % ✓. Using the static resistance R = 2 Ω in step 3 would give U_1m = 0.05 × 2/4, too small.

mistakes.text: 在小信号等效电路里用静态电阻 U_Q/I_Q 代替非线性电阻。增量之间的比例是切线斜率 R_d = du/di|_{Q}，不是 Q 与原点连线的斜率。

en.text: Using the static resistance U_Q/I_Q in the small-signal circuit. Increments are related by the tangent slope R_d = du/di at Q, not by the slope of the line from the origin.

mistakes.text: 把直流和交流分量“叠加”当成精确结果，或者把非线性电阻也化成戴维宁电路。叠加定理和戴维宁定理只适用于线性部分；小信号分析是 Q 点附近的线性近似，信号大了就不准。

en.text: Treating DC + AC superposition as exact, or reducing the nonlinear resistor to a Thevenin circuit too. Superposition and Thevenin apply to the linear part only; small-signal analysis is a linear approximation around Q and fails for large signals.

mistakes.text: 解出二次方程后两个根都保留，或者随手取正根而不检验。每个根都要代回带适用范围的特性（如 i = au² 只对 u ≥ 0）和电路方程；有时两个根都合理，那就是两个工作点。

en.text: Keeping both roots of the quadratic, or taking the positive one without checking. Substitute each root into the characteristic with its range (i = au² only for u ≥ 0) and into the circuit equations; sometimes both pass, and then there are two operating points.

mistakes.text: 分段线性化时只解方程、不检验交点是否落在所设的段内；二极管电路里假设了状态却不检查导通管的电流方向和截止管的电压。

en.text: Solving a piecewise-linear segment without checking that the result lies inside it; in diode circuits, assuming states without checking the current of conducting diodes and the voltage of blocking ones.

mistakes.text: 线性部分含受控源时，把受控源置零后用串并联求 R_0。受控源要保留，用开路电压/短路电流或外加电源法。

en.text: Zeroing a dependent source in the linear part and finding R_0 by series–parallel reduction. Keep the dependent source; use open-circuit voltage / short-circuit current or a test source.

mistakes.text: 默认工作点只有一个。压控型的 N 形特性、流控型的 S 形特性与负载线可能有三个交点；先画图数交点，再逐个求。

en.text: Assuming the operating point is unique. An N-shaped voltage-controlled or S-shaped current-controlled curve can cross the load line three times; sketch and count the intersections first.

mistakes.text: 用动态电阻算功率（P = R_d·I_Q²），负动态电阻时还得出“发出功率”。非线性电阻吸收的功率是 U_Q·I_Q。

en.text: Computing power with the dynamic resistance (P = R_d·I_Q²), and concluding that a negative R_d means power is delivered. The power absorbed is U_Q·I_Q.

en.intro: This chapter covers nonlinear **resistive** circuits only: the equations are no longer linear and superposition fails, but the linear part can still be reduced with Thevenin's theorem. Everything revolves around the operating point — found by curve intersection (the load line), analytically or piecewise-linearly — followed by small-signal analysis with the dynamic resistance. Check every solution against the range where the characteristic holds.
